questions.question: A person spends 25% of the monthly income on rent, 35% on household expenses and groceries, and 40% of the remaining on children’s education and other heads. If the monthly savings are ₹4800, then what is the expenditure on education and other heads?
questions.questionHtml: A person spends 25% of the monthly income on rent, 35% on household expenses and groceries, and 40% of the remaining on children’s education and other heads. If the monthly savings are ₹4800, then what is the expenditure on education and other heads?
questions.solution:
Let monthly income = I.

Spent on rent = 25% of I
Spent on household expenses & groceries = 35% of I
Remaining = 100% − (25% + 35%) = 40% of I

Education & other heads = 40% of the remaining = 40% of 40% of I = 16% of I
Savings = Remaining − Education = 40% of I − 16% of I = 24% of I

Given: 24% of I = 4800
⇒ I = 4800 ÷ 0.24 = 20,000

Expenditure on education & other heads = 16% of 20,000 = 3200

questions.question: A vessel contains 150 liters of milk. 30 liters of milk taken out from the vessel and replaced by water and this operation repeated two more times. Find the ratio of milk and water in resulting mixture?
questions.questionHtml: A vessel contains 150 liters of milk. 30 liters of milk taken out from the vessel and replaced by water and this operation repeated two more times. Find the ratio of milk and water in resulting mixture?
questions.solution:
After each operation, the quantity of milk left =

Milk × (1 − 30/150) = Milk × (120/150) = Milk × (4/5)

Let the initial quantity of milk be 1 unit.

Each time, 1/5 of the mixture is removed and replaced with water.

So, milk remaining after 3 operations = 1 × (4/5)³ = 64/125

Water = 1 − 64/125 = 61/125

Required ratio of milk : water = 64 : 61

questions.question: A pyramid has an equilateral triangular base, each side 10 cm. Its slant edge is 26 cm. Find the whole surface area of the pyramid (in cm²).
questions.questionHtml: A pyramid has an equilateral triangular base, each side 10 cm. Its slant edge is 26 cm. Find the whole surface area of the pyramid (in cm²).
questions.solution:
Area of equilateral triangle base

Side = 10 cm

Area = (√3 / 4) × side² = (√3 / 4) × 100 = 25√3 cm²

Height of each lateral triangle

Each lateral face is an isosceles triangle with:

- Base = 10 cm

- Slant edge = 26 cm

Height of lateral triangle = √(26² − 5²) = √(676 − 25) = √651 cm

Area of one lateral triangle = (1/2) × base × height = (1/2) × 10 × √651 = 5√651 cm²

Total lateral surface area = 3 × 5√651 = 15√651 cm²

Total surface area

= Base area + Lateral area

= 25√3 + 15√651 cm²

questions.questionHtml:
Find the range, mode, and median of the data:
8, 12, 15, 14, 10, 12, 18, 20, 12, 16, 14
questions.solution:
Arrange in ascending order

8, 10, 12, 12, 12, 14, 14, 15, 16, 18, 20

Range = Highest − Lowest = 20 − 8 = 12

Mode = Most frequent value = 12 (appears 3 times)

Median = Middle value (since n = 11, odd number) → 6th value = 14

Final answers: Range = 12; Mode = 12; Median = 14

questions.question: A cube has side 10 cm. A right circular cylinder of radius 3 cm and height 10 cm is drilled straight through the cube from the centre of the top face to the centre of the bottom face. Find the total surface area of the resulting solid.
questions.questionHtml: A cube has side 10 cm. A right circular cylinder of radius 3 cm and height 10 cm is drilled straight through the cube from the centre of the top face to the centre of the bottom face. Find the total surface area of the resulting solid.
questions.solution:
Surface area of cube

Each face = side² = 10² = 100 cm²

Cube has 6 faces → Total = 6 × 100 = 600 cm²

Cylinder drilled through cube

Cylinder radius = 3 cm, height = 10 cm

Lateral surface area of cylinder = 2πrh = 2 × π × 3 × 10 = 60π cm²

Subtract top and bottom circular faces of cube (now open)

Each circular face area = πr² = π × 9 = 9π cm²

Total removed = 2 × 9π = 18π cm²

Total surface area of resulting solid

= Cube surface area − 2 circular faces + lateral surface of cylinder

= 600 − 18π + 60π = 600 + 42π cm²

Final Answer: 600 + 42π cm²

questions.question: Find the equation of the line which makes an angle of 45° with the positive X-axis and passes through the point (4, –2).
questions.questionHtml: Find the equation of the line which makes an angle of 45° with the positive X-axis and passes through the point (4, –2).
questions.solution:
Given:

Angle = 45°, Point = (4, –2)

Slope of line = tan(45°) = 1

Equation of line: y – y₁ = m(x – x₁)
⇒ y – (–2) = 1(x – 4)
⇒ y + 2 = x – 4
⇒ y = x – 6

questions.question: The variance of five values is 64. If each value doubles, find the standard deviation?
questions.questionHtml: The variance of five values is 64. If each value doubles, find the standard deviation?
questions.solution:
Formula:
If each value is multiplied by k,

Given:
Variance = 64

Standard deviation = √64 = 8

Each value is doubled ⇒ k = 2

New standard deviation = 2 × 8 = 16

questions.question: The average weight of 12 persons decreases by 0.75 kg when a person weighing 70 kg is replaced by a new person. What is the weight of the new person?
questions.questionHtml: The average weight of 12 persons decreases by 0.75 kg when a person weighing 70 kg is replaced by a new person. What is the weight of the new person?
questions.solution:
Decrease in average = 0.75 kg

Total decrease in weight = 0.75 × 12 = 9 kg

New person’s weight = 70 − 9 = 61 kg

questions.question: If a circle touches all the four sides of a quadrilateral ABCD at points P, Q, R and S, then which of the following statements is correct?
questions.questionHtml: If a circle touches all the four sides of a quadrilateral ABCD at points P, Q, R and S, then which of the following statements is correct?
questions.solution:
If a circle touches all four sides of a quadrilateral, it's called a tangential quadrilateral.

Property: Sum of opposite sides is equal

→ AB + CD = BC + DA

Correct option: AB + CD = BC + DA
